candidate_program.name: compatible_peak_balance
candidate_program.rationale: Balances root reward against the strongest excluded rival and rewards preserving a strong compatible contact. Reaches the residual complement through a maximum scan; set construction and scanning are still paid per candidate.
candidate_program.rule: (weight - 0.4 * max_conflict_weight + 0.2 * compatible_peak) / (1 + weight + max_conflict_weight + compatible_peak) - 0.1 * degree / (1 + remaining_count)

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
